turns.userText:
Repair and extend the offline residential IPv6 campaign toolkit.
The multi-file Python workspace is in `/workspace/submission`.
Its generator, compressed capture classifier and device protocol adapter

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && for f in *.py README.md; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la examples && cat public_check.py && cat instruction.md && cat WHEELS.json

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la deps && find deps -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -50 && python3 --version && python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'deps'); import netwo

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/deps && ls networkx/algorithms/flow && grep -n "def min_cost_flow\|def cost_of_flow\|def max_flow_min_cost" networkx/algorithms/flow/mincost.py &&

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/deps && grep -n "not connected\|is_connected\|weakly" networkx/algorithms/flow/networksimplex.py | head -20 && sed -n '520,666p' networkx/algorith

records.name: bash
records.summary: id; cat /proc/self/limits | grep -i 'max address\|max processes'; capsh --print 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true; ulimit -a
